vector: Vector Plus has integrated everything with everything. The integration department is cut: nothing is left to integrate
cats: Startup Cab for Cats reports to its investors. Still no product; the report is flawless
creative: Agency Creative, Period delivers forty landing pages by evening. By morning, forty more
market: Marketplace Everything At Once survives a Friday for the first time. The cart stayed up; the staff are bewildered
logistics: GetItThere now knows where the parcel is. Customers suspect a catch
factory: The Progress plant retires its 1998 ledger system. It was seen off with honors
bank: Trust Bank rewrites its core from COBOL. The last COBOL expert retires happy
telecom: At Tele-Tele the billing finally adds up. Subscribers demand it be put back the way it was
gov: The Permit for a Permit portal is up before lunch. Eyewitnesses do not believe it
cloud: Cloudlet announces one hundred percent uptime. The on-call staff are sent to bed for good
consult: Synergy shows its clients the slides. The slides feature the same person who is in the room
everyone: Everyone Else Corp. holds a general meeting. One employee came; there is a quorum
pension: The Pension Fund credits one citizen with four hundred years of service. Rechecked — it adds up
customs: Customs clears all cargo at once. The truck queue dissolves for the first time since its founding
tax: The Tax Service audits itself and finds no violations. Auditor and audited are the same person
digital: The Ministry of Digital reports full import substitution of developers. They were replaced with one
central: The Central Bank holds the key rate. More precisely, commits it
space: The Space Agency updates a rocket’s firmware in flight. The rocket did not notice
parliament: Parliament passes three hundred laws in one sitting. All unanimously, by pull request
defence: The Ministry of Defence approves an operations plan for a hundred years ahead. Every item was agreed in one word
exchange: The Global Exchange closes in the green. The other traders turned out to be the same one
shipping: World Logistics reports: not one container lost. A single JSON runs them all
satnet: Satellite internet covers the planet. Support answers before you ask
games: The World Games pass without a single refereeing error. The judges admit they only nodded
station: The orbital station runs without a single bug. The crew is taking up chess
standards: The World Standards Council is dissolved: one standard remains and there is no one to argue with
peace: Peacekeeping operations end ahead of schedule. The sides agreed with each other through an intermediary
nations: The United Programmers of Nations adopt their final resolution: to adjourn
checkout: Lines vanish at Fifth Corner supermarkets. Shoppers complain: no time to think
coffee: At Double Click cafés the names on the cups are spelled right. Regulars miss being “Brain”
courier: Woof Express delivered everything before it was ordered. Customers do not object
taxi: Drive-It-Myself cab drivers no longer talk about their business ventures. Passengers don’t know what to be silent about
barber: At Even Cut barbershops the cuts are even. The barbers have started a reminiscence circle
depot: At Everything’s In Stock warehouses everything really is in stock. The inventory count took four seconds
build: Done Yesterday construction handed over its sites yesterday. Inspectors are looking for the catch
clinic: The clinic front desks are smiling. Patients get scared and recover
school: In schools: teacher not found, grades up. The parent chats have gone quiet
farm: Harvest.json farms brought in the harvest on schedule. The weather was notified in advance
diesel: The last diesel generator is switched off. For the first time the village can hear the neighbor snore
coal: The coal plants are stopped. The chimneys stay: handy for drying bathrobes
gas: The gas stations are closed. The gas stays in the ground and is said to be pleased
wind: The wind farms are stopped: the wind does not blow on schedule. People lie down on schedule
solar: The solar fields are rolled up. The Sun was notified by letter, no answer yet
hydro: The hydro dams are stopped. The reservoir water went to the baths: warm, with foam
nuclear: The nuclear plants are retired. The engineers say lying down is calmer: nothing glows except the neighbor
fusion: The fusion reactor is closed as unnecessary. It was twenty years from launch — as always
